headline: About the paper
body_html:
The Ledger has printed on Thursdays since 1954. It is owned by its staff, and has been since the 1981 buyout.

Corrections run on page two, above the fold, at the same size as the piece they correct.

headline: How we handle corrections
body_html:
If we get something wrong, tell us. Say what was published, what is wrong with it, and, where you can, what the right version is.

We do not quietly edit a published piece. A correction is added, dated, and signed.

headline: Contact the desk
body_html: The news desk is staffed from 07:00 to 20:00. Outside those hours, leave a message; someone reads them at 07:00.
